defects_fixed.before: Operations were listed outside the OpenAI parameter contract, leaving persona-language routing underspecified.
defects_fixed.after: Each operation now has a deterministic enum and persona-oriented description in the tool parameter schema.

defects_fixed.before: Output language could imply execution, assignment, dispatch, movement, supplier action, or outbound communication.
defects_fixed.after: The agent recommends options only; inventory movement and policy changes require approved tools and authorized owners. Every output labels the fixed data and exact figures as synthetic.

defects_fixed.before: The agent covered only multi-warehouse transfer rebalancing; the demo video's portfolio story ($5M inventory, 30% slow-moving, 95% full warehouse, 90-day recovery plan, warehouse and financial impact, execution timeline, monitoring) had no operations. Holding cost was computed as ~100% of inventory value, transfer projections never subtracted outbound moves, and the cost trade-off used unexplained multipliers.
defects_fixed.after: Added portfolio_analysis, recovery_plan, warehouse_impact, financial_impact, execution_timeline and monitoring_plan carrying the video's figures computed from one consistent data set (slow-moving $1.5M incl. a $250K other-slow-movers bucket, $1.2M recovered = 24%, $640K annual savings, 7,329% ROI); holding cost is now 13.5% of inventory value, the transfer projection subtracts outbound units, and the multipliers were removed. All outputs remain recommendations; nothing is liquidated, returned, moved or posted.

claim_policy: Public catalog and architecture copy is qualitative. Exact figures and identifiers appear only in clearly labeled synthetic evidence.
